role: Site Reliability Engineer Network Intern - OneIT - Austin, TX
jd:
Introduction

At IBM, work is more than a job - it's a calling: To build. To design. To code. To consult. To think along with clients and sell. To make markets. To invent. To collaborate. Not just to do something better, but to attempt things you've never thought possible. Are you ready to lead in this new era of technology and solve some of the world's most challenging problems? If so, lets talk

Your Role And Responsibilities

IBM is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented IT Administrator intern with an interest in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and/or Networking Reliabillity Engineering (NRE) to join our team. These roles offers hands-on experience in enterprise IT systems management while introducing you to modern reliability engineering practices. You’ll work alongside experienced professionals to support infrastructure operations and contribute to automation and performance initiatives.

Your Role and Responsibilities

Specific To Administrator And SRE Role



- Assist in maintaining and supporting enterprise IT systems including servers, virtual machines, and cloud environments.
- Monitor system performance and help identify reliability issues.
- Support automation efforts for routine administrative tasks using scripting tools.
- Participate in incident response and post-incident analysis.
- Help document system configurations, operational procedures, and reliability metrics.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams on infrastructure and service delivery

Your Role and Responsibilities

Specific To Network Administration And NRE Role



- Assist in configuring, monitoring, and maintaining network devices including routers, switches, and firewalls.
- Support day-to-day network operations, troubleshooting connectivity issues and escalating as needed.
- Participate in network performance analysis and reporting.
- Learn and apply automation techniques to reduce manual tasks and improve reliability.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams on network upgrades, deployments, and incident response.
- Document network configurations, procedures, and reliability metrics.

Preferred Education

Bachelor's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise



- Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
- Strong understanding of IP (internet protocol) and other network administration protocols.
- Proven analytical and problem-solving abilities.
- Juniper/Arista/Cisco network General education.
- Ability to conduct research into IT networking issues and products as required.
- Team-oriented and skilled in working within a collaborative environment.
- Familiarity with scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash).
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Effective communication and collaboration abilities.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience



- Exposure to cloud platforms (IBM Cloud, AWS, Azure).
- Interest in SRE principles such as automation, observability, and fault tolerance.
- Interest in NRE principles such as fault tolerance, observability, and incident response.
- Familiarity with monitoring tools (e.g., Wireshark, SolarWinds, Grafana).
- Understanding of cloud networking (IBM Cloud, AWS, Azure).
- Familiarity with monitoring tools (e.g., Grafana, Prometheus).
- Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD concepts.
fit_why: Network admin and router/switch/firewall focus, not software engineering

Bachelor's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

Skills We’re Looking For



- Understanding of client-server architectures and networking protocols.
- Experience with application development and databases.
- Ability to design scalable APIs, servers, services, and applications.
- Familiarity with Agile development methodologies.
- Strong communication, design, and testing skills.

role: 2027 Associate Software Engineer Intern - Sophomore Only
jd:
The RRS Group, and its affiliated entities (collectively, “RRS”) have provided real estate development and related services to investment-grade clients for decades. Our expertise encompasses site acquisition, architectural design, and development management for commercial office and industrial properties.


Through an integrated service model, RRS delivers comprehensive enterprise solutions that address every phase of the building lifecycle. In addition to technical excellence, we offer strategic consulting in marketing, financial planning, and facility management ensuring that every project achieves its highest potential in performance, value, and sustainability.


Commitment to Community


For over two decades, RRS has maintained a strong commitment to the communities we serve. This commitment is further advanced through the RRS Making Lives Better Foundation, which provides meaningful support and resources to individuals and families in need. The Foundation reflects our belief that corporate success carries a responsibility to contribute positively to society and to improve the quality of life in the regions where we operate.


Our Core Values


Integrity | doing the right thing when no one is watching and acting with uncompromising honesty. We believe in maintaining lasting relationships based on honesty, consistency and the highest ethical standards. This creates credibility in our personal and professional relationships.


Caring | showing concern, empathy and compassion for others, ourselves, and our environment. Our care shows itself in our commitment to “safety first” in all we do. We encourage each other to be the best and hold each other accountable. We help those in need, contribute to the communities in which we work and develop creative ways to be responsible with our resources.


Integration | working unselfishly toward common goals across disciplines, teams, departments and regions. Our collective contributions are greater than our skills. We will be transparent and understand each other’s expertise to provide the most value when delivering our services to one another and our clients.


Innovation | developing new ideas and applying the solutions that differentiate us in valuable ways. We are not comfortable with the status quo. We remain accountable for continuous improvements in our results because we do not consider innovation an end in itself. We maintain an environment where we foster new ideas and encourage changes that help us improve.


If you share these core values, we have the right opportunity for you










As an Associate Software Engineer Intern, you will have the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a collaborative, international environment while working alongside experienced technology professionals. This internship is designed for sophomore students who are developing their technical foundation and are eager to apply their academic knowledge to real-world software engineering challenges.


This is a highly selective opportunity with only nine positions available for the 2027 internship cohort.


What You'll Do


As an Associate Software Engineer Intern, you may contribute to:

- Support the development, testing, and enhancement of software applications and internal technology solutions.
- Write, review, and troubleshoot code under the guidance of experienced software engineers.
- Apply software engineering principles to real-world business and technology challenges.
- Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, testing, and debugging activities.
- Collaborate with software engineers, technology professionals, business stakeholders, and international team members.
- Translate technical requirements into practical software solutions.
- Assist with identifying and resolving application issues and defects.
- Document technical solutions, development activities, and processes.
- Participate in Agile or collaborative development practices.
- Learn and apply new technologies, programming languages, frameworks, and development tools.
- Contribute ideas that improve the efficiency, quality, and scalability of technology solutions.


Required Qualifications

- Currently enrolled in a bachelor's degree program and classified as a Sophomore for the 2026–2027 academic year.
- Expected graduation date of December 2028 or August 2029.
- Minimum 3.0 cumulative GPA.
- Coursework, academic projects, personal projects, or prior experience demonstrating an interest in software engineering.
- Experience with at least one of the following:
- Java
- C/C++
- .NET
- Python
- JavaScript
- HTML
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to collaborate effectively with team members from different countries, cultures, and professional backgrounds.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to learn new technologies and adapt to changing priorities.


Preferred Qualifications
Candidates may stand out with experience in:

- Software development projects, internships, or co-op programs.
- Object-oriented programming and software engineering fundamentals.
- Git or other version-control systems.
- Web application development.
- Database concepts and SQL.
- APIs and application integrations.
- Cloud technologies or modern development platforms.
- Automated testing and debugging.
- Agile/Scrum development environments.
- Technical documentation.
- Collaborative projects involving geographically distributed or international teams.


Compensation
The base pay range for this role is $39.75 – $49.50 per hour.
Work Hours: Varies upon the needs of the global department.


RRS Group is an EEO Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. RRS will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.


RRS Group will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable local law, including the requirements of Article 49 of the San Francisco Police Code.

role: Machine Learning Developer Intern / Stagiaire développeur en apprentissage automatique
jd:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is rooted by long term relationships and close collaboration with clients across the globe.

You'll work with visionaries across multiple industries to improve the hybrid cloud and AI journey for the most innovative and valuable companies in the world. Your ability to accelerate impact and make meaningful change for your clients is enabled by our strategic partner ecosystem and our robust technology platforms across the IBM portfolio, including Software and Red Hat.

Curiosity and a constant quest for knowledge serve as the foundation to success in IBM Consulting. In your role, you'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, investigate ideas outside of your role, and come up with creative solutions resulting in groundbreaking impact for a wide network of clients. Our culture of evolution and empathy centers on long-term career growth and development opportunities in an environment that embraces your unique skills and experience.

About Business Unit

IBM Consulting is IBM’s consulting and global professional services business, with market leading capabilities in business and technology transformation. With deep expertise in many industries, we offer strategy, experience, technology, and operations services to many of the most innovative and valuable companies in the world. Our people are focused on accelerating our clients’ businesses through the power of collaboration. We believe in the power of technology responsibly used to help people, partners and the planet.

Your Role And Responsibilities

Our team is looking for candidates with exceptional technical aptitude, a passion for applied data science, and an interest in solving business challenges with machine learning.

The successful candidate will join a fast-paced consulting team, composed of Partners, Product Managers, Data Scientists, Architects and Software Engineers to conceptualize, develop and deploy machine learning solutions to solve enterprise-scale problems. As a team, we pride ourselves on tackling some of the most difficult challenges our clients face by bringing together subject matter expertise, data science, and technical execution.

Requirements

As an Intern Machine Learning Developer, you’ll have the unique opportunity to learn and use industry-leading ML technologies on a cloud platform (e.g. IBM Cloud, Azure, AWS or Edge) by working on a project that generates value for external client engagements or internal initiatives. Depending on the projects and team’s technical requirements, you will have the opportunity to work with technologies such as:



- GenAI/Agentic AI Frameworks and Models - AutoGen, LangGraph, LLM, Microsoft Agent Framework
- Spark, Kafka
- PyTorch, Tensorflow CUDA
- Computer Vision

This position resides in Toronto or Montreal and is a 4-month work term commencing in January 2027. All applicants must be eligible to work full-time in Canada and enrolled full-time in an eligible post-secondary program. It is mandatory that applicants return to full-time studies upon completion of the work term. Candidates pursuing Bachelor's or Master's degrees are eligible. MBA and PhD candidates are not eligible for this opportunity.

Preferred Education

Bachelor's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise



- Demonstrated familiarity or interest in machine learning, statistical analysis, or data mining through previous internships, personal/academic projects, hackathons, and/or publications.
- Experience with one or more scripting languages (Python preferred), or a proven computer science foundation.
- Hands-on experience with GenAI tools (eg. langchain, semantic kernel, etc.) and LLM concepts (prompt-engineering, RAG, etc.).
- Able to confidently communicate ideas to an audience of peers/managers, comfortable and effective in working independently and as a member of a cross-functional team.
- Must be eligible to work full-time for 4 Months starting in January 2027.
- Candidates considered for a Quebec position must be fluent in French.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience



- One or more work terms in a machine learning, computer vision or software engineering related role.
- Experience using machine-learning or data engineering libraries/frameworks in python (scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Pyspark).
- Hands on R&D to develop software demos and prototypes.
- Support delivery project teams in areas such as AI, ML, Automation, LLM on major cloud providers. 
- Good familiarity with cloud application development and the tools required for building cloud-native data applications (Kubernetes, Docker, storage, etc.).
- AI and Cloud services working experience on Azure, AWS, or GCP are assets.
fit_why: Python, GenAI/RAG and Docker fit; ML frameworks are a gap

L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. Fundamental to our culture is an unwavering focus on values, dedication to our communities, and commitment to excellence in everything we do.

L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

Full Stack Developer Co-op

Reference #44088

Waterdown, Ontario

About L3HARRIS WESCAM

As a subsidiary of L3Harris Technologies and within the Integrated Mission Systems Segment, the WESCAM division develops the most advanced optical sensor and targeting systems for global defense and military sectors, National Security, Search & Rescue and Airborne law enforcement agencies. From long-range covert surveillance missions to search and rescue operations, our MX-series systems, and the mission systems solutions they are a part of, produce stabilized high-magnification electro1-optical and infrared images from airborne, marine and ground based platforms, enabling our customers to see first and act first.

About The Role

This is a 16 month co-op term (with 12 month terms occasionally available). You will be reporting to the Manager, Applications & Collaboration Services, and working closely on a team of talented individuals.

Primary Responsibilities



- Design, develop and support functional and system Software applications to validate production assemblies and systems
- Automate processes to eliminate manual test, logs and papers during software development
- Responsible for creating and maintaining C# and SQL based custom internal applications
- Create technical speciﬁcations and test plans, additional functions may include ad-hoc report generation, and data mining activities
- Provides programming support for various interfaces
- Work closely with Operations, Production, and IT on continuing to build new test capabilities while improving existing test procedures and methods
- Assist in conducting root cause analysis and implementing corrective actions for production issues that arise internally
- Support quality practices (AS9100 and ISO9001)


Required Capabilities



- Experience developing functional software, test scripts and/or automation systems
- Proficiency with DevOps, C#, ASP.NET, MS SQL is an asset
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Creative and innovative
- Strong working knowledge of standard internet communications protocols (TCP/IP, Ethernet etc.)
- Basic knowledge of Microsoft applications


Desired Education And Experiences



- Working towards University Degree in Computer Science or Software/Computer Engineering
- Must be able to complete a 16 month Co-Op term starting May 2027
- Currently enrolled and in good standing with co-op program through accredited university
- Able to obtain Canadian Controlled Goods Program (CGP) clearance

We are committed to diversity and inclusion within our L3Harris WESCAM family, and our community by welcoming and encouraging applications from anyone interested without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran's status, Aboriginal status or any other legally-protected groups.
